messages:
Maya: opened PR touching Private installer networking + KMS/HSM (PR #4378). quickcoord for a single-NIC HSM NAT edgecase.

Ashley: saw the diff, nice. what's failing in the field?

Maya: in some images a global POSTROUTING SNAT rewrites HSM mgmt traffic and vendor consoles lose connectivity. current quickstart nft example is too broad.

Sam: can you paste the minimal bad rule so we can show a fix?

Maya: bad: `iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j SNAT --to-source $PUBLIC_IP`
Effect: rewrites container/bridge-origin mgmt flows.

Priya: suggest three fixes in the doc: (1) scope SNAT with `-s`, (2) use `MASQUERADE` for ephemeral clouds, (3) add an accept rule for mgmt ports before SNAT.

Ashley: +1. tiny style: render ports as code (`8700`, `8743`) and keep commands copy/pasteable.

Maya: adding this nft example and connmark quickline to troubleshooting: ``nft add rule nat postrouting tcp dport {8700,8743} counter accept`` and an iptables scoped example. will push shortly.

docs-bot: Linkcheck: found a broken anchor from installer -> private/kms (404). please fix before merge.

Maya: fixed crosslink and pushed commit 2 (link + snippets). PR: https://redwood.internal/docs/pr/4378

Sam: i'll do a final pass and merge once linkcheck clears. thanks!
